design_condition: Withdrawn from the surrounding streets and closely aligned with the larger neighboring school while respecting smaller buildings, the compact volume creates generous forecourts and a clear campus access axis.

positive.statement: The spacious forecourts and respectful distance from the small-format neighboring buildings create a convincing urban relationship.
The two entrances form a striking cross-street access axis to the campus.
The atrium and access cascade create generous lounge and learning areas while bringing daylight deep into the building.
The use ring is separated from the static measures so that the areas can be divided flexibly.
The well-proportioned classrooms can easily be divided into group rooms.
The compact building follows a strict, repetitive logic, so an economical solution can be assumed.
The project convincingly implements the demands for resource efficiency and low operating costs.
The use of daylight in all rooms is excellent.
The open-space design impresses with surprising diversity and carefully interweaves with the architecture.

negative.statement: The equipment rooms under the sloping skylight are structurally very complex.
The dimensions and dominance of the bus shelter and double-decker bicycle parking are not yet completely convincing.
Delivery has only a waiting area, so material must be transported out of the weather, and there is no planning statement about disposal.
Access to the roof area remains unclear despite the planned photovoltaic system.
